cohort: 110 pregnant women attending antenatal check-ups at a hospital in Hyderabad, Telangana, India, with detected or documented thyroid dysfunction
finding: Women with thyroid dysfunction experienced higher rates of adverse pregnancy outcomes, including increased abortion rates, caesarean deliveries, preterm births, and low birth weight.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery showed no significant variation between hypothyroidism and hyperthyroidism groups.
birth_weight: low birth weight (lbw) babies were observed in women with thyroid dysfunction
